Method of Attack: Encryption of files using different methods based on file size (partial encryption in 5MB stripes after every 200MB for files >3GB, full encryption for files ≤3GB)
Drops ransom notes warning victims not to contact law enforcement or negotiation firms
Threatens DDoS attacks and repeated breaches if ransom demands are not met
Impacted Systems: US organizations in the financial sector
Attack Vector: Use of BazarLoader malware for reconnaissance
